name: tryll-meet-notes
description: Calendar-driven meeting bot: joins Google Meet via Vexa, transcribes with speakers, generates notes with Claude, saves .docx to Google Drive

scripts.test:authstate: docker cp scripts/vexa-image/tryll-authstate.cjs vexa-lite:/tmp/tryll-authstate.cjs && docker cp scripts/vexa-image/test-authstate.cjs vexa-lite:/tmp/test-authstate.cjs && docker exec vexa-lite node /tmp/test-authstate.cjs
scripts.test:bot: npm run -s typecheck && npm run -s test:guest-policy && npm run -s test:authstate-patch && npm run -s test:auth-verdict && npm run -s test:authstate && npm run -s test:vexa-patch && npm run -s test:gmeet-turns
